agents.claude.safeguardHelp.text: In its terminal: /feedback reports a false positive, /model switches back, and /config sets whether it switches models by itself when a message is flagged.
agents.claude.safeguardHelp.note: What to do after Claude Code's safety classifier stopped a response (an agent's safeguard note). /feedback, /model and /config are commands: keep them.

agents.codex.safeguardHelp.text: Codex sends a request it flags to another model, or stops the turn. For security work, OpenAI’s Trusted Access for Cyber program lifts that.
agents.codex.safeguardHelp.note: What happens after Codex's safety check flags a request (an agent's safeguard note). Trusted Access for Cyber is the name of OpenAI's program: keep it.

agents.fileLock.ask.note: A file lock mode (Settings, a project's settings): the user approves an edit of a file another agent is editing. Keep it short.

agents.fileLock.askDescription.text: The edit waits for your approval, like a permission prompt.
agents.fileLock.askDescription.note: What the Ask me file lock mode does.

agents.fileLock.block.note: A file lock mode (Settings, a project's settings): an agent may not edit a file another agent is editing. Keep it short.

agents.fileLock.blockDescription.text: An agent that tries to edit a file another agent is editing is told to wait or work on something else.
agents.fileLock.blockDescription.note: What the Block file lock mode does.

agents.fileLock.off.note: A file lock mode (Settings, a project's settings): no locking. Keep it short.

agents.fileLock.offDescription.text: Agents edit freely. Use with care when several agents share the project folder.
agents.fileLock.offDescription.note: What the Off file lock mode does.

agents.fileLock.warn.note: A file lock mode (Settings, a project's settings): the edit goes ahead with a warning to the agent. Keep it short.

agents.fileLock.warnDescription.text: The edit goes ahead, and the agent is told another agent is editing the file.
agents.fileLock.warnDescription.note: What the Warn file lock mode does.

agents.limit.most.text: A project can have up to {most, number} agents.
agents.limit.most.note: Why another agent can't be added to a project: it has as many as Combwork allows ({most}, 24).

agents.limit.workflow.text: This project’s workflow allows {max, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}}: raise Maximum agents in Version Control → Workflow.
agents.limit.workflow.note: Why another agent can't be added to a project (HI-2058): its workflow option Maximum agents allows {max} and it has that many. Maximum agents, Version Control and Workflow are names in the window: as translated there.

agents.merge.blocked.text: {why, select, waiting {{agent} is waiting for your answer. Merge once it has finished.} background {{agent} is waiting on background tasks it started. Merge once it has finished.} watching {{agent} is waiting for cards to change (a card watch) and carries on when they do. Merge once it has finished, or cancel its watch first.} signin {{agent} stopped in the middle of a task when its sign-in expired. Sign in again and let it finish first.} other {{agent} is working. Merge once it has finished.}}
agents.merge.blocked.note: Why a worktree agent's work can't be merged now ({agent}: its name), by what it is doing: answering the user (waiting), waiting on its own background tasks, waiting for cards to change (a card watch), stopped by an expired sign-in, or working (other).

agents.provider.extraArgsDashes.text: Combwork passes the task after "--"; remove it from extra arguments. For an option whose value is "--", write --option=--.
agents.provider.extraArgsDashes.note: Why extra arguments for a CLI are refused: they contain a bare "--". Keep "--" and --option=-- exactly as they are.

agents.resume.hold.after.text: {agent} is on {kind, select, card {{work}} other {its lane}} in {slot}: resume this after {kind, select, card {{work}} other {its lane}}.
agents.resume.hold.after.note: Why a conversation can't resume now (#1434): its agent ({agent}) builds a card ({work}: "AM-14"; kind card) or a lane (kind lane) in another slot ({slot}: "slot-a"), and this conversation is in the slot the agent kept: it resumes once that work ends.

agents.resume.hold.byHand.text: Its slot ({slot}) is free: Resume takes it for {agent} again. Resume All and startup leave it, so free slots stay for new work.
agents.resume.hold.byHand.note: A conversation's note (#1434): the slot it ran in ({slot}: "slot-b") is free and as it left it, so the user's own Resume takes it again for its agent ({agent}); Resume All and Combwork's startup don't.

agents.resume.hold.changed.text: This conversation's slot ({slot}) has changed since it ran, so it can't resume there. Read its transcript, or start fresh with a handover.
agents.resume.hold.changed.note: Why a conversation can't resume (#1434): the slot it ran in ({slot}: "slot-b") is free, but its files or its revision changed since (or it isn't set up).

agents.resume.hold.draining.text: This conversation's slot ({slot}) is still being handed back from its last session. Try again in a moment.
agents.resume.hold.draining.note: Why a conversation can't resume just now (#1434): the slot it ran in ({slot}: "slot-b") is free, but its last session there is still exiting and Combwork hasn't finished taking the slot back. It can be resumed in a moment.

agents.resume.hold.gone.text: This conversation's slot ({slot}) is gone from disk. Read its transcript, or start fresh with a handover.
agents.resume.hold.gone.note: Why a conversation can't resume (#1434): the slot folder it ran in ({slot}: "slot-b") no longer exists.

agents.resume.hold.holds.text: {agent} already keeps {slot}. Release that slot to resume this conversation in its own.
agents.resume.hold.holds.note: Why a conversation can't resume (#1434): its agent ({agent}) already keeps another slot ({slot}: "slot-a"), and an agent keeps one at a time.

agents.resume.hold.reused.text: This conversation's slot ({slot}) now holds {kind, select, card {{work}'s work} other {a lane's work}}. Read its transcript, or start fresh with a handover.
agents.resume.hold.reused.note: Why a conversation can't resume (#1434): the slot it ran in ({slot}: "slot-b") was lent to other work since: a card's ({work}: "AM-14"; kind card) or a lane's (kind lane). Reading its transcript and starting fresh with a handover are what the window offers.

agents.resume.hold.reviewer.text: {agent} reviews now, and reviewers never run in a slot ({slot}). Read its transcript, or start fresh with a handover.
agents.resume.hold.reviewer.note: Why a conversation can't resume (#1434): its agent ({agent}) has the reviewer role now, and reviewers work in the project folder, never in a slot ({slot}: "slot-b").
